task: Is there a better USDC supply yield than 4.2% at 10000 USD, clearing a 50 bps threshold?
method: manual viem reads against Venus vUSDC, annualized by hand, no marketplace agent
caveats: This is a gross supply APR for one venue. It is not net of gas, slippage or the cost of exiting the current position.
It does not account for the size actually deployed, so it is not a net APR at size.
The annualization depends on an assumed block time, which is a manual research step and a source of error.
conclusion: Venus vUSDC does not clear the 50 bps threshold on a gross basis.
